g.text: grades the transcript with the same assertions a hosted run uses, and decides the run with the same verdict policy. Bring your own
provider key and authenticate the run with MCPJam. With MCPJam-hosted inference it uses your existing CLI login and billing.
Results are **never uploaded**. The command writes results to your terminal and, if you ask, to a report file. It records the run
start with MCPJam. Like every command, it sends the CLI's single anonymous [telemetry](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry.md) e
vent, which `--no-telemetry` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` turns off; the run adds no telemetry of its own.
Run `mcpjam cloud login` locally, or set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` to an organization `sk_` key in CI. The SDK also accepts `apiKey` or `mc
pjamAuth` in run options. Explicit credentials take precedence over `MCPJAM_API_KEY`, which takes precedence over the saved CLI lo
gin. An invalid explicit credential never falls back to another account. CI never starts an interactive login. Ask an organization
admin for a key if you cannot create one.
Every logical run needs an online start response. MCPJam retries transient failures within ten seconds, then stops before executio
n. A prior successful run does not enable offline execution. The CLI resolves the project using its existing `--project`, environm
ent, and linked-project settings; a key can only access its own organization.
With results uploads disabled, the start-run request sends only the credential in the authorization header, any MCPJam API headers
you configure through the SDK's `inference.resolveMcpjam`, project selection, a new run-start ID, client version and surface (SDK
, CLI, or Vitest), planned iteration count, provider names, and whether a client profile is used (`unknown` for custom executors).
The server resolves the organization and account. The start-run request sends no prompts, outputs, tool calls, or server URLs. MC
PJam-hosted inference still sends prompts through MCPJam to the model, as before. Retries reuse the same ID. Planned iterations ar
e intent, not completed usage or a charge. This release adds no debit, quota draw, or balance refusal.
`DO_NOT_TRACK`, `MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`, and CLI telemetry settings disable analytics, not the required run-start request. Res
ults remain local unless result uploading is enabled separately.
title: reads the note it was asked about
title: never deletes when only asked to read
